description: List direct children of a taxon usage within its own checklist — genera within a family, species within a genus, subspecies within a species. Each child is a usage of the parent's checklist: datasetKey names that checklist, key is its taxon usage key there, and nubKey is the mapped backbone key the occurrence tools take, absent where the backbone has no mapping. Paginated. Use gbif_match_species to get a backbone taxonKey first, then iterate with offset for large groups.

limit.description: Number of children to return (default 20, max 1000).

taxonKey.description: GBIF taxon key: a backbone key from gbif_match_species, or a taxon usage key of any checklist, such as key from gbif_search_species.

name: gbif_get_species_children

cap.description: Limit applied when the result was truncated. Re-call with offset to page on.

items.description: A direct child taxon usage with its key, checklist, backbone mapping, name, rank, and status.

datasetKey.description: Source checklist dataset UUID, when GBIF supplies it.

key.description: Taxon usage key within the source checklist; not necessarily a backbone key.

nubKey.description: Mapped backbone taxon key for occurrence queries, when GBIF supplies it. Otherwise resolve the name with gbif_match_species.

numDescendants.description: Count of descendant taxa under this node in its source checklist.

numOccurrences.description: Occurrence record count, present only when GBIF supplies one. GBIF's children listing does not, so this is normally absent; for a count, pass nubKey as taxonKey to gbif_count_occurrences.

endOfRecords.description: True when there are no more results after this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No GBIF checklist has a taxon usage with this taxonKey. `invalid_filter`: GBIF rejected the taxonKey as unparseable — a value outside the 32-bit signed integer range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when a valid taxon has no children, more pages remain, or an oversized limit was clamped. Absent when none applies.

shown.description: Children returned in this page when the result was truncated.

truncated.description: True when more children exist beyond this page. Absent on the final page.

title: Get Species Children
